test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which programme or allocation head has emerged as the biggest beneficiary in the Union sports budget for the financial year 2022-23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khelo India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **Union Sports Budget for the financial year 2022-23**, the biggest beneficiary was the **Khelo India Scheme**.
 
• The Ministry has furnished an Expenditure Finance Committee (EFC) memorandum to the Ministry of Finance for extension/continuation of the Khelo India Scheme from 2021-22 to 2025- 26,
 
• A number of Rs 8750 crore has been estimated as a financial implication of the new Khelo India Scheme (2021-22 to 2025-26) in the EFC memorandum furnished to the Ministry of Finance.
 
• An amount of Rs 657.71 crore has been allocated in the Budget Estimate (B.E.) for the year 2022-23 under the Khelo India Scheme.
 
• This information was given by former Minister of State for Youth Affairs & Sports Shri Kiren Rijiju.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Service Scheme**

 
 
• **​**NSS **aims to develop the personality and leadership qualities o**f students through community service.
 
• It e**ncourages youth to engage in social service activities** and helps them become responsible citizens.
 
• It **primarily targets students in universities, colleges, and schools.**
 
• Volunteers engage in community-based activities, often related to education, health, sanitation, and environmental awareness.
 
 
 
• **Urban Sports Infrastructure Scheme**
 
 
• **​**This **scheme aims to develop and upgrade sports infrastructure in urban area**s to promote sports and physical activities among citizens, particularly the youth.
 
• The **scheme provides financial assistance to state and Union Territory governments** for creating and improving sports facilities such as sports complexes, stadiums, and playgrounds in urban areas.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Talent Search Scheme (NSTSS)**
 
 
• **​​​**NSTSS **aims to identify and nurture young talent in various sports disciplines across India**
 
• It ensures that the country produces world-class athletes for international competitions.
 
• Under the scheme, talented athletes are provided with scholarships and advanced training under expert coaches.
 
• The **focus is on identifying talent early and providing them **with the necessary resources for their development.
